title: Nvidia's Blackwell and Rubin Chips Will Have $1 Trillion in Lifetime Sales. What Does That Mean for Nvidia's Stock? - The Motley Fool
summary: Nvidia's Blackwell and Rubin Chips Will Have $1 Trillion in Lifetime Sales. What Does That Mean for Nvidia's Stock? The Motley Fool
body:
Nvidia (NVDA +0.87%) has given investors some jaw-dropping projections over the past few years, and during the company's 2026 GTC event, CEO Jensen Huang gave investors another one to unpack.

Huang told investors that the management expects $1 trillion in lifetime sales for their current-generation Blackwell chips and next-generation Vera Rubin chips by the end of 2027. The market has basically ignored this commentary, as the stock has declined since the projection was given.

However, I think investors need to be taking this project a lot more seriously than the market is, as it could be signaling that Nvidia has far greater upside ahead.
